arc.energy_shape_notes: Three acts in a staircase, each peak louder than the last: Act I peaks -6.0dB at 3:20, Act II -5.9dB at 7:05, finale -4.5dB at 11:05 (99% of runtime). Two cliffs punish the peaks (-6.0 -> -17.1dB in 10s at 3:30; -5.9 -> -15.1dB by 7:25) with immediate rebuilds. Ends at maximum with no fade and no comedown - cut off mid-sentence at full volume.

progression_alt_third_ambiguity: F maj/min ambiguity in Act I (0:30-1:00): both thirds present in chroma - possible third-toggle, unconfirmed, low confidence (0.56-0.64)

harmony.home_scale: F natural minor (F G Ab Bb C Db Eb); middle act drops a whole step to Eb minor (D# min, 3:30-7:15), then F minor returns to the end
signature_devices: Whole-step modulation as the middle act: F -> Eb minor for a full third of the runtime (3:30-7:15) at the highest key confidence in the track (0.71-0.84, chroma up to 0.98), then back to F.
Third ambiguity on a static F root in Act I (F maj/min flip, both thirds in chroma) - flagged, not claimed as a toggle; needs a stem pass.

Ends on the tonic F (chroma 0.94 at 11:10) with no V-i anywhere and no leading tone - home in the literal sense, unresolved in the functional sense. Key estimator confidence collapses (0.44-0.56) in the final minute under the loudness; trust the chroma, not the label.

Stepped accelerando: per-minute 103.4 (0:00-4:00) -> 129.2 (4:00-6:00) -> 136.0 (6:00-end), stepping at the act boundaries. Doom that gets faster instead of slower. Opening 103.4 unconfirmed (downbeat spacing implies ~138 throughout; 103.4 ~ 3/4 of 138 suggests an estimator misread) - the steps are the device, not the exact opening figure.
beat_times_s are downbeats (~33.9/min), not beats - same correction as ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS.
Cliff after the peak, rebuild immediately: -6.0 -> -17.1dB in 10s at 3:30, -5.9 -> -15.1dB by 7:25; recovery starts in the next window - never dwell in the valley.
No onset analysis was run - drum pattern is an assumption from album context, not a measurement (see report Honest Limits).

tempo.feel: Stepped accelerando: starts slow (per-minute 103.4, unconfirmed) and gathers speed at each act boundary to a 136 BPM finale. The tempo is the escalation.

timbre.palette_notes: Bright rebuilds, dark cliffs, ceiling-pinned master. Centroid mean ~2750Hz (range 1043-3719Hz), rolloff mean ~5550Hz, ZCR mean ~0.12 (max 0.196 at 5:40). Brightest window 3719Hz sits inside the Eb-minor act; darkest windows are the structural seams (1043Hz at the 7:15 hinge, 1181Hz at the 3:30 cliff). Finale darkens as it gets louder (2656 -> 2062Hz while RMS rises to -4.5dB). Peak hits 0.0dBFS in nearly every 30s block - the hottest master of the three tracks analyzed so far (vs OFFLINE peak max -1.1dBFS).
